speech.heard: Slovakia's middle class earns 19.3% of national income. Colombia has 11.5. Colombia has a lower share, a small slice for the middle of the population. Zambia and Zimbabwe are also near the bottom. Zambia has 11.9%. Zimbabwe, 12. This is the share that accrues to the middle quintile of the population. Moving up, the USA has 15.1%. Indonesia has 15.5. Nigeria, 16.4. Slovakia is the world's highest. With 19.3%, it has 1.7 times Colombia's share. How large is the middle class share where you live?
